modelAnswer:
A few weeks later, when I almost forgot the contest, there came the news. My teacher rushed in, waving an envelope, his eyes shining. "First place!" he cried. For a moment I froze, my heart pounding wildly. Then it hit me — I had won. Yet what flooded my mind was not the prize, but those long nights of rewriting, racing forward like Revere's horse whenever I longed to quit.
I went to my teacher's office after the award presentation. He looked up, and that warm laugh I knew so well filled the room. "I told you that you had a good shot," he said. I meant to thank him for the prize, but other words slipped out: "Thank you for making me love writing." Like Revere's horse, I had been tired and full of doubts, yet I had kept going — and somewhere along that road, a painful chore had quietly turned into joy.

continuationDesign.theme: 比起赢，更珍贵的是像 Revere 的马一样坚持后，写作从痛苦变成了热爱——而点燃这一切的是老师的信任。
paragraphs: 第1段承接 starter1"消息来了"：先用老师冲进教室、挥信、眼睛发亮报喜，把"news=获奖"落实，并制造由"愣住—心跳—醒悟"的情绪台阶。关键是顺原文逻辑做一个转折：我没有停在"赢了"的狂喜上，而是让脑海里浮现的是无数个重写的夜晚——这正衔接原文"赢的念头让位于写作乐趣/如果没赢我也不在乎"的伏笔。此处第一次引入 Revere 的马的意象(racing forward...whenever I longed to quit)，与原文"like Revere's horse, I kept going"形成呼应而非复述。

第2段承接 starter2"颁奖后去办公室"：用师生对话收束。先以老师那熟悉的笑(呼应原文反复出现的 laughed out loud)和他的原话"good shot"(回扣原文"I think you have a good shot at this")接住场景；再设计一个微转折——我本想为奖项道谢，脱口而出的却是"谢谢你让我爱上写作"，把主题从"输赢"翻到"热爱"。结尾收束回扣中心意象：像马一样累过、怀疑过却坚持下来，痛苦(painful，原文 difficult and painful)终于化为乐趣(joy，原文 enjoyment of writing)，完成点题升华。

highlightExpressions.text: My teacher rushed in, waving an envelope, his eyes shining.
highlightExpressions.note: 动作链+独立主格：先一个主动作(rushed in)，再用现在分词(waving)串第二动作，最后用独立主格(his eyes shining)补人物神态。报喜/激动登场的万能句式，可迁移到任何"某人带着情绪冲进来"的场景。

highlightExpressions.text: For a moment I froze, my heart pounding wildly.
highlightExpressions.note: 心理描写+独立主格：用"身体定格(froze)+心跳(heart pounding)"外化震惊情绪，独立主格让两层反应叠在一句里。震惊/紧张/意外时刻通用。

highlightExpressions.text: Yet what flooded my mind was not the prize, but those long nights of rewriting
highlightExpressions.note: 情绪转折+not...but 强调结构：用 what 引导的主语从句聚焦内心，再用 not A but B 把读者注意力从表面(奖)拉向真正在意的东西(过程)。适合写"顿悟/价值反转"的高分句。

highlightExpressions.text: racing forward like Revere's horse whenever I longed to quit
highlightExpressions.note: 非谓语作状语+原文意象比喻：用现在分词短语作伴随状语，把"我"的坚持比作奔马，直接回扣原文核心意象。把抽象的"努力坚持"具象成一个原文已有的画面，是续写呼应原文的高分手法。

highlightExpressions.text: yet I had kept going — and somewhere along that road, a painful chore had quietly turned into joy
highlightExpressions.note: 转折收束+点题：用 yet 承前面的"累与怀疑"，再以"painful→joy"的转变点出主旨(呼应原文 difficult and painful 与 enjoyment of writing)。结尾升华句模板：先认怂困难，再用一个安静的转变收束情感。
